Generated metric definitions for ipecho gauges and counters.

# Purpose
This generated header defines metric metadata for the `ipecho` service and gives each metric a fixed offset, name, type, description, and converter setting. It includes one gauge for `ipecho_shred_version` and `ipecho_connection_count`, and four counters for connection close status and byte totals read and written. The `FD_METRICS_IPECHO_TOTAL` value sets the number of metric entries, and the external `FD_METRICS_IPECHO` array exposes the metadata for use by other parts of the codebase. The file is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it serves as a build-time source of truth for metric definitions and must not be edited by hand.
